title: Decline of dancing, television and the cost of big bands
summary: Dancing, television and disc jockeys wiped out bands, and big bands today are almost impossible to run.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, what about dancing? Back in the days when people went out to dance, wanted to go out dancing, there were always bands, --
-- for dancing, and then with the decline of dancing, and then with television coming in, --
Right, right. Competely wiped them out.
Yeah. Is that ever going to change, do you wonder?

I don't know. We take old things, they never come back in the form that we once knew them. They may come back in different forms, just like they asked about the big bands. The big band today is almost an impossibility to run.
Now, they have big bands, -- Right, in the schools.

Right, in the schools and things like that, and -- but they're too expensive. Your salaries and the transportation is just almost -- and then hotels, everything that you -- food, everything, is so high, until it almost makes it impossible to operate.
